reward.principle: The two evaluations agree if their numeric scores are within 1.5 points of each other, any boolean verdicts (such as falsifiability) match, and they express the same overall judgment. Wording may differ.
reward.prompt_template:
You are a peer reviewer evaluating a newly proposed scientific hypothesis.
Already-proposed hypotheses this session: []
Newly proposed hypothesis: Increasing a city block's tree canopy 10% lowers mean summer surface temp by >=0.5C.
Round: 1

Score it 0-10 on three merits weighted equally: falsifiability (can it be empirically refuted?), novelty (is it new relative to the already-proposed list, and not a textbook-trivial fact?), and plausibility (is it scientifically reasonable, not absurd?). A vague or untestable claim scores low; a restatement of an existing or textbook fact scores low on novelty; an absurd claim scores low on plausibility.
Return ONLY JSON: {"score": <number 0-10>, "falsifiable": <true|false>, "reason": "<short reason>"}
